title: Lean-Verified Counterexample to the Final Open n = 4 Case of Ramaekers’s n-Conjecture
whyItMatters: GPT-6 Astra produced a Lean 4-verified counterexample refuting the sole remaining open n = 4 case of Ramaekers’s strong n-conjecture (generalizing the abc-conjecture to 4-tuples).
summary: In 2011, Ramaekers conjectured that the quality of pairwise-coprime integer n-tuples summing to zero with no vanishing proper subsum equals 1 (generalizing the n = 3 abc-conjecture). After Hölzl, Kleine, and Stephan disproved the conjecture for all n ≥ 5, only the n = 4 case remained open. On September 5, 2026, Epoch AI researcher Tom Adamczewski used OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra to discover and formalize in Lean 4 an infinite family of counterexamples settling the final open n = 4 case—a result cataloged among 2026’s landmark AI mathematical discoveries and analyzed alongside human-crafted Lean formalizations in Jeremy Tan’s Redhill paper (arXiv:2610.16323).
technicalHighlights: Extends the disproof of Ramaekers’s strong n-conjecture from n ≥ 5 down to the final open case n = 4, leaving only the classical n = 3 abc-conjecture.
Delivered as a machine-checked Lean 4 proof generated autonomously with GPT-6 Astra.
Independently cited and compared for Lean code structure against human-authored Mathlib-style formalizations in Jeremy Tan’s October 2026 Redhill paper (arXiv:2610.16323).
caveats: Disproves the n = 4 generalization of the abc-conjecture (Ramaekers’s conjecture), not the classical n = 3 abc-conjecture itself; independent Lean formalizers (arXiv:2610.16323) noted that LLM-generated Lean files trade code elegance and Mathlib reusability for rapid kernel certification.

scoreRationale.foundational: Closes the sole remaining open case (n = 4) of a 15-year-old Diophantine generalization of the abc-conjecture.
scoreRationale.ripple: Became a canonical case study in the Lean community comparing autonomous LLM formalizations against human-curated libraries (Redhill).
scoreRationale.verification: Machine-checked in Lean 4 and independently examined by formalization researchers (arXiv:2610.16323).
scoreRationale.velocity: Settled autonomously in Lean 4 immediately following GPT-6 Astra’s September 2026 launch.
